full_judgment:
This Rule calls in question the legality and propriety of the Judgment and decree dated 30.6.88 passed by Subordinate Judge; 4th Court, Dhaka in Title Appeal No. 20987 affirming the judgment and decree dated 30.6.87 passed by Assistant Judge, 6th Court, Dhaka in Title Suit No. 13 of 1985. 

 5. Both parties led evidence in support of their respective contention and the learned Munsif decreed the suit by his judgment dated 30.6.87. 

 6. Being aggrieved by that judgment the petitioner filed an appeal before the District Judge, Dhaka being Title Appeal No. 209 of 1987 and that appeal was heard by Subordinate Judge, 4th Court Dhaka who by his judgment and decree dated 30.6.88 dismissed the appeal and affirmed those passed by the learned Munsif. 

 7. Being aggrieved by the judgment and decree the defendant-petitioner moved the revisional jurisdiction of this Court and obtained the present Rule. 

 8. The learned Advocate appearing for the defendant-petitioner, submits that the Courts below committed error of law resulting in an erroneous decision occasioning failure of justice in decreeing plaintiffs suit inasmuch as plaintiff failed to prove his bonafide requirement for the suit premises either adducing oral or documentary evidence. It is further submitted that the question of bona fide requirement the Courts below have not at all considered the statement of PW 1 which he made in cross-examination that she owns another two storied house and she resides there in the 2nd floor and she further admits that she owned another house at 35, Narinda, Dhaka city. it is further submitted that the service of notice under section 106 of the Transfer of Property Act has not been proved.
